FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. You will be a member of the Fund Reporting FPSE team, reporting to the Head of Fund Reporting .

• Duration: 12 months

• Company Presence: Full-time or part-time (80% - 1 school day per week)

• Set up, control and update of static and dynamic data,

• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations,

• Activation and publication request according to registration status,

• Dissemination of legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports,

• Chargeback of invoices,

• Document collection and organization,

• Scanning and electronic archiving of documents and data’s…

Your profile

• Currently pursuing a master in Finance or Economics

• Knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis

• Any experience or knowledge of the data provider environment would be a plus

• Good Excel skills

Soft skills:

• Flexibility and agility

• Very good interpersonal skills

• Project management and organizational skills

• Contribuire all'esecuzione efficiente e accurata delle operazioni di pubblicazione,

• Richiesta di attivazione e pubblicazione secondo lo stato di registrazione,

• Diffusione della documentazione dei fondi legali, relazioni mensili del portafoglio e relazioni di calcolo NAV,

• Rimborso delle fatture,

• Raccolta e organizzazione di documenti,

• Scansione e archiviazione elettronica di documenti e dati...

Il tuo profilo

• Attualmente perseguire un master in Finanza o Economia

• Conoscenza delle operazioni di fondo, processi e analisi dei dati

• Qualsiasi esperienza o conoscenza dell'ambiente del fornitore di dati sarebbe un plus

• Competenze di Excel

Morbide competenze:

• Flessibilità e agilità

• Molto buone capacità interpersonali

• Gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative

La lingua uccide:

• Fluency parlato in inglese e francese

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. • Flexibilité et agilité

Join the Tax Operations Department in Geneva, the Group’s centre of expertise for operational tax within a leading Swiss private bank. We support private clients with comprehensive tax reporting, manage transactional taxes, and maintain strong relationships with tax authorities. As a Business Process Manager (BPM), you will play a pivotal role in transforming and optimizing our end-to-end tax reporting framework. • Drive incident resolution and root cause analysis for complex issues, transforming incidents into lasting improvements and sharing knowledge across teams.

• Planifier et améliorer les processus opérationnels, identifier les points de douleur et quantifier les gains de productivité et la réduction des risques.

• Agir à titre d'expert en matière d'améliorations des processus, en collaboration avec les TI et les intervenants opérationnels, afin de s'aligner sur les limites des processus et les améliorations stratégiques.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Your role

As key member of the Pictet Asset Management (PAM) Asia Equity Special Situations team, this role supports the Lead Portfolio Manager by conducting investment research across Asia-Pacific equity markets, with a focus on identifying liquid, event-driven trading opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain proprietary financial models (including LBO, DCF, NAV, relative value comparables and merger arbitrage spread analyses) and clearly articulate trading ideas to internal stakeholders.

• Proactively monitor announced corporate events and quantify key risk factors, risk/reward profiles and market‑implied expectations, updating assumptions in a timely and rigorous manner.

• Maintain active dialogue with sell-side analysts, meet company management teams and participate in relevant industry conferences.

• Contribute to portfolio risk monitoring and help implement a robust framework to mitigate factor risks across sub‑strategies.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Law or Mathematics; industry qualifications such as the CFA are an asset.

• Experience on the buy side (e.g. hedge fund) or at a global investment bank, with a focus on equities, investment banking or quantitative investment.

• Proven experience in Asian equity markets, with a solid understanding of M&A and equity capital markets; index rebalance expertise is a plus.

• Familiarity with Asia-Pacific market regulations, including Japan and Australia.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; results‑oriented, driven and a collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Strong knowledge of Bloomberg and Excel, including VBA; exposure to Python is an advantage.

The successful candidate is versatile, self‑motivated, detail‑oriented and highly diligent. You will demonstrate strong financial, risk management and regulatory knowledge, and work in a disciplined, rigorous and forward‑thinking manner. You will also be able to build and maintain effective working relationships with key business stakeholders.
